name: orchestrator-accept-step
about: An escalation whose recommendation needs the user's hand first (step, #533): Accept records a pending accept and the item stays in needs_you while the buttons give way to 'Done — re-queue'; Done records the recommendation as the answer and re-queues the item once, so the agent never asks again before the step is done.

body.text: the runner log needs a look before the retry
body.recommendation: grep the runner log, then retry the run
body.reason: the log is on your box
body.step: grep the runner log for item 1
